summary: Android/ Investigate opportunity detect "data issues" with "Not response" app

ai.s: Investigated how to detect and prevent Android "No response" app freezes that appeared simply after logging in and waiting.
ai.pr: On Android build 8358 the app showed "No response" after login with no further user action, observed on a Samsung Galaxy A56 5G running Android 16.
ai.wy: App stability: unresponsive-app dialogs after login degrade the attendee experience.
ai.oc: An investigation into how such data-related "No response" issues can be detected and prevented on Android.

summary: [TechDept] Category remove fail when client has no BM database

ai.s: Fixed category removal in the admin categorisation page failing for clients who have no legacy BM database.
ai.pr: Removing a category triggered ProductGroupsEvents::beforeDelete and BM Category::removeItem, which accessed the retired BM database, throwing a fatal PDOException for new clients.
ai.wy: Tech debt: the BM database is no longer used or created for new clients, so dependent code breaks.
ai.oc: Category removal no longer depends on the obsolete BM database, so organisers can delete categories without errors.

summary: Conutry Manager: System merges duplicate Cities within Region so that Location data remains consistent across Events

ai.s: A script merges duplicate City records within the same Region so location data stays clean and consistent across events.
ai.pr: Duplicate City records within the same Region made location data inconsistent across events and needed manual clean-up.
ai.wy: Data quality in the Country Manager: consistent Cities and Regions without manual intervention.
ai.oc: A command-line or scheduled script that automatically merges duplicate Cities within a Region; regions, countries, UI and live-event merges are out of scope.

summary: Understand two rows in account_event for owner

ai.s: Investigated why some exhibitors have two owner rows in account_event with different accounts, to understand the data inconsistency.
ai.pr: Exhibitors 1135, 1143 and 1195 each had two account_event owner records with different account_ids, statuses, registration codes and account information.
ai.wy: Data integrity: duplicate owner records create ambiguity about who owns an exhibitor profile.
ai.oc: An analysis of the two owner rows per exhibitor, comparing status, registration code, activation and account information fields.

summary: Country Manager: Organizer selects City from type-ahead dropdown to prevent multiple records for one city so that Location data remains consistent across Events

ai.s: Organisers pick a City from a type-ahead list in Add City, auto-filling its region and coordinates, so duplicate city records are avoided.
ai.pr: A free-text City name input let organisers create multiple records for one city through slight spelling variations such as New York and New Yorke.
ai.wy: Keep Country Manager location data accurate and consistent across events.
ai.oc: A type-ahead City dropdown after three letters that auto-populates and locks Region, Latitude, Longitude and Timezone, while still allowing new Cities.

summary: Allow Contact Person or Admin to Manage Multiple Exhibitor Companies from a Single Login

ai.s: A contact person or admin can manage multiple independent exhibitor companies from one login instead of juggling separate accounts.
ai.pr: A team member email could be tied to only one exhibitor company, forcing pavilion managers and agencies to use multiple logins or an unsuitable parent-child structure.
ai.wy: Requested by DLG for pavilions with 30+ co-exhibitors; parent-child is not GDPR-suitable for independent companies.
ai.oc: Support for one login to manage several independent exhibitor companies, estimated at 12 to 18 days including design, backend, frontend and QA.

summary: ON HOLD - [FE] Client Manager: Centralising Lead Features under Lead Capture + for Event Organizers

ai.s: A new Lead Capture + top-level admin menu groups Lead Capture Pro and Custom Lead Questions so organisers find lead features in one place.
ai.pr: Lead-related configuration was spread across Event Setup and Registration Settings, making lead features hard for organisers to discover and manage.
ai.wy: Improve discoverability and usability of lead features without changing functionality.
ai.oc: A Lead Capture + menu after Management, holding Lead Capture Pro and Custom Lead Questions, with no behavioural changes; the story is on hold.

summary: Need to extend error map for SES

ai.s: Extended the SES bounce error map so every code returned by Amazon SES maps to the correct email status.
ai.pr: Some SES bounce codes appeared to be wrongly assigned to the EMAIL_NO_EXIST status because the error map did not cover all returned codes.
ai.wy: Accurate email delivery statuses; misclassified bounces mislabel valid addresses.
ai.oc: Support for the full set of SES bounce codes, so bounces are classified correctly rather than defaulting to EMAIL_NO_EXIST.
